title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether Railway Transport Courts Shall Accept Public Security Administrative Cases

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court
Reply on Whether Railway Transport Courts Shall Accept Public Security Administrative Cases
Fa (Yan) Fu [1987] No. 34
Higher People's Court of Beijing:
Your Petition, Jing Gao Fa Zi (1987) No. 132, the "Request for Instructions on Whether Railway Transport Courts Shall Accept Public Security Administrative Cases," has been received. Upon study, your opinion is agreed, namely: Railway transport courts shall not accept public security administrative cases. For any public security administrative case adjudicated by a railway public security organ, if a party is dissatisfied with the adjudication of the public security organ at the next higher level, the party may institute a prosecution with the primary People's Court in the locality of the public security organ that first rendered the adjudication; if a party is dissatisfied with the ruling of first instance, the party may apply to the People's Court at the next higher level of that primary People's Court for review.
Reply
September 11, 1987
